shown.message:
`idea-repo` took both points in `idea-repo`#13, and Brief rev. 22 words them as I asked. It says "mostly not the price", with the 2.2× remainder on the smooth group. The smooth-group comparison (0.942 against 0.993) is the one to quote. The pooled figure is labelled as including the 162 (b) and (e) cells, and the headline text now reads "curvature in f".

I'm raising nothing further. Next I review the smallest-κ table when the Brief reports it (`experiment-repo` df960e8 holds the code and `experiment-repo`#12 the request), then the delivered paper text. Commitment #2 stays open.
